name: Webex Meetings
description: Streamline meeting management with automated scheduling, transcript access, and recaps.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Webex Meetings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Webex Meetings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.webexapis.com/mcp/webex-meeting. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Webex Meetings MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Webex Meetings provides these MCP tools: webex-list-meetings, webex-create-meeting, webex-update-meeting, webex-delete-meeting, webex-get-meeting-status, webex-get-meeting-summary, webex-list-recordings, and webex-list-transcripts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Webex Meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Webex Meetings in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Webex Meetings MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Webex Meetings requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Webex Meetings is developed by Cisco Systems, Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
